title: Reversible Secondary Myelofibrosis or Clonal Myeloproliferative Disorder
brief_summary: To determine the prevalence of myelofibrosis in patients with primary pulmonary hypertension, and to discover if the fibrosis in these patients is primary (AMM) or secondary.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. \> 18 years of age
2. Signed Informed Consent
3. Subjects diagnosed with Primary Pulmonary Hypertension or Myelofibrosis (primary or secondary)

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Anyone not meeting the above inclusion criteria
2. Pregnant women
study_population: Patients suffering from primary pulmonary hypertension or myelofibrosis (primary or secondary)
